label: Transformed Advaitic non-dualism into egalitarian vernacular Virashaiva bhakti
description: While inheriting South Indian non-dual (Advaita) ontology of ultimate oneness, Akka Mahadevi and the Lingayat Anubhava Mantapa repudiated Shankara's Brahmanical caste restrictions on Vedic renunciation, opening mystical realization to women and lower castes.
dialecticalTension: Replaces Sanskritic monastic elitism with embodied Kannada vachana egalitarianism.

label: Prefigured bridal mysticism and radical defiance of patriarchal marriage
description: Akka Mahadevi's refusal of earthly royal marriage in favor of exclusive devotion to Chennamallikarjuna established the paradigmatic South Asian female Bhakti ethic later echoed across North India by Mirabai.
dialecticalTension: Asserts female spiritual sovereignty by subverting patriarchal kinship obligations.
historicalContext: Trans-regional Bhakti continuum from 12th-century Karnataka to 16th-century Rajasthan.

citations.author: Vijaya Ramaswamy
